knobs.name: sP
knobs.what: world units per orbit unit: size of the position-space tangle

knobs.name: sL
knobs.what: world units per unit of spin length: the radius of the six shells

knobs.name: sW
knobs.what: world units per unit of the weight-space picture (the network, before the move)

knobs.name: sC
knobs.what: world units per unit of the network's fixed sums: the radius of its three shells

knobs.name: layerGap
knobs.what: world units between the five energy layers

knobs.name: dotR
knobs.what: dot radius of the orbit cloud, world units (bigger reads closer)

knobs.name: dotRNet
knobs.what: dot radius of the training cloud, world units

knobs.name: speckGrow
knobs.what: how much larger the dots grow once they sit on their specks (ten dots share one speck)

knobs.name: hiGrow
knobs.what: how much a lit dot (featured orbit, cut set) swells beyond its size

knobs.name: sizeCue
knobs.what: depth cue: nearer dots are larger (0 = none)

knobs.name: fog
knobs.what: fog toward the sky for the far side of a cloud (manager level cap 0.3)

knobs.name: featDim
knobs.what: how far the rest of the cloud sinks while the followed orbit or run is lit

knobs.name: stag
knobs.what: delay between orbits as the dots travel (0 = all at once; cap 0.25)

knobs.name: dimEarth
knobs.what: how far the orbit cloud sinks into the sky while Earth's fixture is on stage

knobs.name: dimGhost
knobs.what: how far the orbit cloud sinks while the network is on stage

knobs.name: starN
knobs.what: number of faint stars in the sky

knobs.name: starR
knobs.what: star radius, world units (they sit 3,000 away)

knobs.name: starDim
knobs.what: star brightness: 0 = full muted, higher sinks them into the sky

knobs.name: wireR
knobs.what: radius of the dotted guide rings and ellipses

knobs.name: wireDim
knobs.what: how faint the dotted guides are (higher = fainter)

knobs.name: plate
knobs.what: opacity of the ground plate behind pins and set type

knobs.name: swayDeg
knobs.what: degrees: calm sway of the camera about its aim point (0 = still between moves)

knobs.name: swayPeriod
knobs.what: s: period of the sway

knobs.name: hold
knobs.what: frames a pin must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels)

knobs.name: leader
knobs.what: length of a pin's leader, sheet units

knobs.name: pinHold
knobs.what: s: how long a new number stays still (floor 2.5)

knobs.name: pinFade
knobs.what: s: fade of a pin in and out

knobs.name: dispAdv
knobs.what: width of one display-face character in ems, for placing pins

knobs.name: honestSize
knobs.what: size of the honest line on stage, sheet units

knobs.name: featOrbit
knobs.what: which of the 300 orbits is followed (its ten dots, its ellipse, its spin arrow)

knobs.name: featRun
knobs.what: which of the 100 training runs is followed

knobs.name: cutBandPct
knobs.what: percent: the cut keeps orbits whose spin points within this share of the equator plane (changes the lit count)

knobs.name: cutTop
knobs.what: world units: height the cut plane starts from

knobs.name: earthTheta
knobs.what: degrees: where on the page the closest point sits

knobs.name: arrowK
knobs.what: world units of arrow per km/s (both arrows share it, so their lengths stay in true proportion)

knobs.name: earthDot
knobs.what: radius of Earth's two dots and the Sun, world units

knobs.name: fbY0
knobs.what: sheet y of the first formula line

knobs.name: fbY1
knobs.what: sheet y of the second formula line

knobs.name: fbSize
knobs.what: size of the formula type, sheet units

knobs.name: fbBind
knobs.what: s after a run starts: the terms take their colours

knobs.name: fbFly
knobs.what: s after a run starts: the first word flies to its mark

knobs.name: fbFlyS
knobs.what: s: length of a word's flight

knobs.name: fbComp
knobs.what: s after a run starts: the first number flies back into the formula

knobs.name: fbCompS
knobs.what: s: length of a number's flight

knobs.name: fbGap
knobs.what: s between the first and the second flight (words and numbers never cross)

knobs.name: fbRes
knobs.what: s after a run starts: the product starts to count up

knobs.name: fbResS
knobs.what: s: length of the count-up

knobs.name: fbLift
knobs.what: sheet units: arc of a flying term (0 = straight)

knobs.name: ringR
knobs.what: world units: radius of the smoke ring

knobs.name: ringTube
knobs.what: world units: radius of the ring's tube

knobs.name: ringW
knobs.what: radians per second the air circles round the tube

knobs.name: ringV
knobs.what: world units per second the ring travels

knobs.name: tReveal0
knobs.what: s: the first orbit's dots count in

knobs.name: tReveal1
knobs.what: s: the 3,000th dot is in (the count lands; keep <= 26.0)

knobs.name: tFeat0
knobs.what: s: the followed orbit's ten dots start to light, one by one

knobs.name: tFeat1
knobs.what: s: the tenth dot is lit

knobs.name: tPFeat
knobs.what: s: the pin 'ONE ORBIT' appears

knobs.name: tPCount
knobs.what: s: the first count lands: '3,000 moments, 300 orbits' (never before 26.0)

knobs.name: tPRp
knobs.what: s: the closest distance lands (hold 2.5)

knobs.name: tPVp
knobs.what: s: the speed there lands

knobs.name: tPRa
knobs.what: s: the farthest distance lands

knobs.name: tPVa
knobs.what: s: the speed there lands

knobs.name: tRun1
knobs.what: s: the formula runs for the closest point (set, bind, fly, compute)

knobs.name: tRun2
knobs.what: s: the formula runs again for the farthest point

knobs.name: tCall
knobs.what: s: 'only 0.011 % apart' lands (a ratio, after both products)

knobs.name: tSpin
knobs.what: s: the spin arrow of the followed orbit and its pin appear

knobs.name: tPSame
knobs.what: s: pin 'the same dots' lands

knobs.name: tPSpecks
knobs.what: s: pin '300 specks' lands

knobs.name: tPShells
knobs.what: s: pin '6 shells' lands

knobs.name: tPTrill
knobs.what: s: the callout 'under 1 in a trillion' lands

knobs.name: tPCut
knobs.what: s: the lit count lands: '62 orbits lit'

knobs.name: tPLay
knobs.what: s: pin '5 layers' lands

knobs.name: tTable
knobs.what: s: the table (turn: spin, shells; day: energy, layers) appears

knobs.name: tNet0
knobs.what: s: the first training step counts in

knobs.name: tNet1
knobs.what: s: the 3,000th training dot is in

knobs.name: tFRun0
knobs.what: s: the followed run's thirty dots start to light, one by one

knobs.name: tPFRun
knobs.what: s: the pin 'ONE RUN' appears

knobs.name: tPNet
knobs.what: s: the second count lands: '3,000 steps, 100 runs'

knobs.name: tPlateNet
knobs.what: s: the plate with the sum that should not change appears

knobs.name: tPN3
knobs.what: s: pin '3 shells' lands

knobs.name: tPW
knobs.what: s: pin 'the weights travelled' lands

knobs.name: tPC
knobs.what: s: pin 'the fixed sum moved' lands

knobs.name: tPRatio
knobs.what: s: the callout 'about 250 times less' lands

knobs.name: tRing0
knobs.what: s: the wordless smoke-ring plate starts

knobs.name: tSwap
knobs.what: s: the two airs swap colours (the swirl stays)

knobs.name: tQ
knobs.what: s: the question for Monday appears

knobs.name: tHonest
knobs.what: s: the honest line appears on stage
